decision.observation: At 11:20 pm the farmer stands atop the pier's landward wooden platform beside the FISH shop; the boardwalk with bench and lamppost extends east, water to the right/far side.
decision.hypothesis: The sandy beach lies above/north of the pier; moving up then right onto the open sand may reveal the path back to Pelican Town.
decision.memory: Ledge beside shop; pier extends east; beach sand expected north.
